name: Props namespace (look / morph)
what: Lets an outside editor store a block's look inside the block's own props so it travels with the content.
how: Keep a plain object prop (e.g. look) and give it a hidden object field { type: 'object', objectFields: {}, visible: false } so Puck's field walks leave it alone.
risk_note: Any change re-runs resolveData, dotted keys are split in the canvas, and a resolver returning a whole new object overwrites it.

name: Extra top-level key on a block
what: Stores an aesthetic document next to props on each block, outside the field system.
how: Put a key beside type/props (e.g. style); Puck spreads the item in replace, duplicate, move and resolve so it is kept.
risk_note: The block render never receives it on the published route, and the root loses unknown keys on replaceRoot.
v024: same: Render still hands blocks only props/id/puck (puck-0.24.0/dist/rsc.js:854-900)

name: Metadata side-car keyed by block id

how: Pass the document as the metadata prop of Puck and Render; each block reads puck.metadata and its own id.
risk_note: Duplicate gives new ids so entries are orphaned, and it is outside Puck history.
v024: same: metadata still passed as puck.metadata; Render now also forwards fieldTransforms (rsc.js:930)

name: useGetPuck

v024: same: usePuck projection region identical apart from renamed react import
